brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: Three stacked half-n bases: piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,2;half-n vertically stacked via snaps at 0,0,0 and 0,0,1
drawer:0#0,0#cut at level 0 and drawer:1#0,0#cut at level 1 on south cut faces of half-n bases

requirements.requirement: One of them shown pulled open
requirements.evidence: setDrawerOpen at 0,0,0 open=true; lower drawer is extended, upper drawer remains closed; check_build meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built 3-high vertical cabinet from half-n bases. Added two drawers on the cut faces at levels 0 and 1, leaving top cell as closed/open compartment. Set lower drawer to open with setDrawerOpen, verified with check_build (ok, mesh clear).

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
